mapper.update: UPDATE activity_registration SET status = 1, registered_at = NOW(), cancelled_at = NULL WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 2
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity_registration WHERE activity_id = #{activityId} AND status = 1

SELECT r.id AS registration_id, r.activity_id AS id, r.status AS registration_status, r.registered_at, a.title, a.club_id, c.name AS club_name, a.location, a.category, a.start_time, a.end_time, a.signup_deadline, a.capacity, a.joined_count, a.status, a.cover_color FROM activity_registration r INNER JOIN activity a ON a.id = r.activity_id INNER JOIN club c ON c.id = a.club_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY a.start_time DESC, r.id DESC
